text: At the Hadrow Flats survey site on Tuesday morning, field geologist Mara Venn told the Baywater Gazette she and her team confirmed a seam of potash during the second round of core sampling. Venn said the deposit was first flagged by a bright band in the drill readings, then verified in lab tests at the temporary trailer on site. “We saw the salt-bearing layer at 43 metres,” she said, holding up a sample jar dusted white along the inside. The survey team, working for Northmere Exploration, logged the find at 9:20 a.m. near Plot C-14. By late afternoon, technicians had fenced off the borehole and posted fresh markers around the area.
